structureKind: pitched clay-tile roof with airwell and rear court
motionPotential: explodable named facade and roof assemblies
objectClass.notes: Reference-detail fidelity is highest on the upper street facade. The end-wall, airwell and rear-court elevations are typological inference and must remain quieter than the documented facade.

reasoning: The identity depends on more than the narrow rectangular mass: the projecting upper storey, continuous five-footway and pitched roof must all survive the silhouette pass.
Three full-height paired French-window bays, colored fanlights, balustrades, pilasters, floral tile spandrels and cornice brackets create dense repeated meso and micro geometry.
The public street facade is documented; the end wall, airwell and rear court require conservative typological inference and separate review views.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A complex tier is required because recognizability depends on layered facade depth, five repeated ornamental systems, multiple material families, and credible inferred hidden elevations.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Whether the gallery object represents a mid-row party-wall bay or a corner/end bay; this rebuild treats it as an end bay so an orbit does not present an empty slab.
The reference does not reveal the exact airwell length, rear service-block depth, or rear-court configuration.
Exact floral tile motifs and plaster relief profiles are simplified to geometry and palette rhythms rather than copied photographic textures.

details.description: A dense repeating perforated timber fascia forms the deep top eave shadow line.
details.affects: eaves negative space and top silhouette

details.description: Multiple narrow plaster cornice bands step outward beneath the eaves and above the windows.
Projecting floral capitals cap the pilasters at both ends of the three-window composition.
One small oval plaster-framed ventilation opening is centered above each window bay.
Rectangular multi-pane fanlights above the three French windows alternate purple, blue, green and amber glazing.
Each full-height French opening carries two side-hung timber jalousie leaves with narrow horizontal louvers contained within the leaf frames.
details.scale: meso six shutter leaves with micro slats

details.description: Slender vertical balusters sit across the lower portion of each full-height opening without covering the fanlights.
Glazed floral tile panels with pink blossoms and green foliage fill the spandrels below the outer window bays.
Recessed rectangular timber panels and stiles sit beneath the central French opening.
Vertical grooves and stepped edge mouldings articulate the pilasters between and beside the window bays.
Subtle vertical ochre streaking and value variation appear on the pale green painted plaster near the end pilaster.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: At catalogue-card distance the model reads as a narrow Singapore Peranakan shophouse with a projecting upper storey, sheltered five-footway, three correct full-height window assemblies, colored fanlights, balustrades, floral tile spandrels, layered plaster cornices, and a clay-tile roof.
Front, three-quarter, side, and rear-court views show real depth and attached parts; no view may collapse into a blank slab or expose floating windows, roof sheets, or ornament.

featureGroups.name: Narrow shophouse mass, upper projection, five-footway and roof
qualityCriteria: The plan remains visibly narrow and deep, the upper facade projects over a continuous five-footway, and the roof is split by an airwell before a smaller rear service block.
failureModes: the model reads as a freestanding box with a porch
the roof spans the full depth as one uninterrupted slab
the five-footway is a platform without sheltered passage depth

featureGroups.name: Three full-height French-window assemblies
qualityCriteria: Each bay has a recessed full-height opening, paired side-hung shutters, a colored multi-pane fanlight, vertical balustrade and lower timber panel; shutter leaves are not replaced by flat horizontal bar stacks.
failureModes: windows read as vents, ladders or surface decals
balustrades are missing or cover the shutter faces

featureGroups.name: Pilasters, floral tile spandrels, cornices and eaves
qualityCriteria: Pilasters frame the three bays, floral tile panels sit below the openings, and layered cornice/eaves geometry creates shadow lines without floating off the facade.
failureModes: ornament is represented by unrelated floating blocks
the cornice reads as one oversized signboard

featureGroups.name: Residential ground front, pintu pagar and five-footway
qualityCriteria: A recessed double-leaf door, half-height pintu pagar, flanking casement windows, columns, floor edge and covered ceiling form a coherent sheltered passage.
failureModes: columns block the doorway or sit outside the walkway edge
the pintu pagar fills the full door height
the ground windows repeat the upper French-window proportions

featureGroups.name: End-wall, airwell and rear-court credibility
qualityCriteria: The end bay has restrained compatible casement windows and drainpipe relief, the airwell visibly breaks the roof, and the rear court has a service door and compatible windows without claiming exact historical plans.
failureModes: a three-quarter orbit shows a featureless six-metre wall
rear windows float beyond the wall plane
roof panels intersect or leave a visible open seam

visualDeltaChecks: narrow depth-to-frontage ratio and upper-storey projection delta
three-window bay width, height, fanlight and shutter-angle delta
five-footway clear passage and column-spacing delta
pilaster, floral-tile, cornice and eaves repetition delta
airwell break, end-wall fenestration and rear-court depth delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
